description: This file defines utility functions, macros, and constants for buffer management, byte order encoding/decoding, memory allocation, and hash format identifiers used in the reftable component of a version control system, with some functions related to buffer manipulation, byte order conversions, and memory management.

methods.name: reftable_buf_init
methods.description: Initializes a reftable buffer for use.

methods.name: reftable_buf_release
methods.description: Releases memory associated with a reftable buffer and reinitializes it.

methods.name: reftable_buf_reset
methods.description: Resets the buffer to be empty without releasing memory.

methods.name: reftable_buf_setlen
methods.description: Sets the length of the buffer, writing a NUL byte at the new end.

methods.name: reftable_buf_addstr
methods.description: Appends a string to the buffer.

methods.name: reftable_buf_detach
methods.description: Detaches the buffer's memory for use by the caller.

methods.name: reftable_put_be16
methods.description: Encodes a 16-bit integer in big-endian order.

methods.name: reftable_put_be24
methods.description: Encodes a 24-bit integer in big-endian order.

methods.name: reftable_put_be32
methods.description: Encodes a 32-bit integer in big-endian order.

methods.name: reftable_put_be64
methods.description: Encodes a 64-bit integer in big-endian order.

methods.name: common_prefix_size
methods.description: Finds the longest shared prefix size of two buffers.
